reviewNotes: HOLD. Current official KT evidence resolves recharge validity, passport acquisition, short-stay identity limits and the roaming blocker. The route remains valuable negative knowledge but is not an overseas OTP/long-term nonresident route; no publication change.

events.outcome: KT now provides an exact recharge-validity ladder up to KRW50,000/365 days, but passport-only usage is short-term/90-day constrained without further identity verification and Welcome Prepaid excludes roaming.

data.acquisitionSummary: KT Welcome Prepaid is available to foreign visitors and can be activated with a passport; KT also documents one prepaid line per subscriber. Short-stay/tourist positioning remains explicit.

keep.action: A KRW50,000 prepaid recharge grants 365 days validity on the standard prepaid recharge table. This does not override immigration/stay-period identity limits; users without foreigner-ID registration are limited to 90 days unless identity is reverified/extended in-store.

data.chinaActivation: New signup is an in-Korea/visitor acquisition path. Overseas activation is not established, and the current Welcome Prepaid product explicitly does not provide roaming.
data.kyc: KT states prepaid can be signed up with a standard passport. Short-term C-type visitors are directed to Welcome Prepaid; users without a registered foreigner identification number can use service only for 90 days unless they visit a store for real-name verification/extension.
data.payment: Recharge is available online/ARS, at KT retailers, and via automatic top-off; exact overseas-card acceptance is not established.
data.roamingSms: Current KT Welcome Prepaid product terms state roaming is not provided, so this route is not an overseas SMS/OTP route.
data.refund: Recharge amounts are non-refundable; remaining balance is not returned on cancellation.
data.holdReason: The recharge table supports up to 365-day balance validity, but tourist/passport-only service is time-limited unless identity status is extended and the current prepaid product does not provide roaming. It is unsuitable for overseas OTP retention.
data.tariffSummary: Welcome Prepaid starts at KRW35,000/30 days; standard prepaid recharge validity reaches 365 days at KRW50,000, subject to identity/stay-period limits.
guideSteps: Do not equate a 365-day recharge validity with 365-day tourist eligibility.
Treat passport-only acquisition as a short-stay path unless in-store identity extension is completed.
Do not market this route for overseas SMS/OTP because roaming is excluded.
